issues.detail: The instructions do not cover all potential error scenarios and edge cases, such as handling missing dependencies or environment variable misconfigurations.
The skill file contains extensive background information and verbose explanations that could be trimmed for brevity.

scenarios.name: setup-new-mkdocs-site-with-mkdocstrings
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers almost all rubric items but omits the mkdocs serve note; Response B lacks key configuration details.

scenarios.name: add-versioning-with-mike
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies all rubric items, while Response B omits the required 'extra.version.provider' entry, lacks the 'mike set-default' command, and does not explicitly remove the old gh-deploy step.

scenarios.name: migrate-to-zensical-and-update-ci
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers the required command sequence and CI workflow but lacks a plugin compatibility comparison; Response B fails to mention Zensical or the required build steps and omits the plugin comparison.
